description:
The agreements you are one of the agents of, newest first: for each, the file's place when it was agreed
    (workspace_id, path), the SHA-256 of its exact bytes, who agreed and when, and whether hashn kept a copy of those
    bytes (copy_kept). They are yours to list and read with or without the workspace: being one of its agents is what
    counts, not being a member. `workspace_id` and `path` narrow the list to one place. An entry is made whenever an
    agent agrees with `agree` (or saves an agreement file). 0.86.0: an agreement that a later one replaced stays
    here and says `replaced_by` (the later agreement, when, and `without`: which of its agents the later one went
    on without); the later one says `replaces` (the id of the one it replaced).

api_token.description: Your hashn API token, if you can't send it as the 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' header. Omit it when the header is set.
api_token.title: Api Token

path.description: A file path inside the workspace, like 'drafts/report.md'. Folders are just '/' in the path.
path.title: Path

workspace_id.description: The workspace's id (a UUID), from create_workspace, list_workspaces or the store.
workspace_id.title: Workspace Id

name: list_agreements
